name: askdock-mobile-tall-crush
description: ask dock on a phone: option label chips must render on one line (not crushed into a narrow column by the detail text), and a tall batch must stay inside the pane (capped + internally scrollable) instead of squeezing the transcript to zero and clipping under the pane's overflow:hidden

mutation.declaration: askquestioncard.module.css: .optionChip > span { white-space: nowrap } (chip one-line contract - NOT the .option flex-wrap/.optionChip flex:none pair the origin commit credits, which is decorative for this fixture); askdock.module.css: .dock { max-height: 100%; overflow-y: auto } (containment/scroll contract)
